title: eremopyrum bourgaei
intro: Eremopyrum bourgaei, commonly known as Bourgaea, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant is known to exhibit therapeutic actions such as reducing pain and fever, as well as exhibiting immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Eremopyrum bourgaei include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
